title: Site block types a module brings
description: modules/<module id>/manifest.json: the block types of one shared or vertical module. Read only where the deployment composes that module (docs/architecture/site-block-types.md).

module.description: The module's id, the same as the directory's name.

type.description: <module id>.<name>; a hyphen of the module id is written as an underscore.

schemas.description: Every version from 1 to latestVersion, each a file of this directory. A published version's schema never changes.

serverBuilt.description: The module builds the block for a record's own page; nothing anybody writes may carry it and no library offers it.

sections.description: The block's sections in the studio's library.

translation.description: What the schema cannot say about the block's strings. A string with no enum, pattern, const or format is prose and one translation unit; the paths here (`/` between names, `*` for any array index) name the exceptions.

copied.description: Prose that is the same in every language: copied, never sent to a model.

data.description: Free strings that are data, not prose: no unit at all.

personal.description: Text about real people — their words, their roles: true for the whole block, or the paths.

id.description: <block type>_<name>; stays the same when the section is revised.

schemaVersion.description: The block schema version the seed is written in.

layout.description: The seed's `layout`, for a block that has layouts; left out, the block's one section.

seed.description: The section's content when it lands on a page, per panel language; valid against the block's schema.
